SECTION: PMCR01 Gate 0 — executable Y channel map
METHOD: AST walk over the COMMITTED blobs for every write to self.n[species], including species-loop writes; then a deterministic mutation oracle per alleged channel on a NON_SCIENTIFIC_SEMANTIC_FIXTURE.

CHANNELS.NAME: kY  (minority birth coefficient)
CHANNELS.DEFAULT_VALUE: 0.0 at the qualified point (1.9511206603301162e-05 in the inherited MTW01 Spec, a different and non-portable point)
CHANNELS.ADMISSIBLE_RANGE: [0, inf). p = min(1, kY nX nY) is clamped, so values above 1/(nX nY) only saturate. No assert or raise restricts it.
CHANNELS.CONSTRUCTOR_PATH: obtc02_protocol.yaml point.kY -> gate_obtc02.load() -> SPEC['point']['kY'] -> protocol_obtc02.spec_for() {k: PT[k] for k in (...,'kY')} -> lawspec_v2.spec_with() -> type('SpecVariant',(kinetics.Spec,),d) -> World.sp.kY -> engine_obtc.WorldOBTC._react_core
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: _react_core, loop tuple ('Y','SY',sp.kY): p = min(1, kY * nX * nY) ; births = Binomial(min(nSY, free0), p)
CHANNELS.RESOURCE_OR_CAPACITY_DEPENDENCE: candidates are min(nSY, free) at the Y's OWN cell; free = CAP - occupancy; both must be >= 1
CHANNELS.EVENT_ORDER: 5th of 7: diffuse X, Y, SX, SY -> REACT -> decay -> exchange
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: PARTIAL. Same-step isolated (the X branch is drawn first, arguments bit-identical). NOT isolated across steps: p_X = min(1, kX nX nY) reads nY, and a surviving Y birth adds a source cell once it separates.
CHANNELS.INDEPENDENTLY_CONTROLLABLE: yes, with respect to muY: different field, different operator, disjoint captured hazard arguments

CHANNELS.NAME: muY (minority removal probability)
CHANNELS.DEFAULT_VALUE: 0.0 at the qualified point (1.9511206603301160e-06 in MTW01)
CHANNELS.ADMISSIBLE_RANGE: [0, 1]; it is the p of rng.binomial(n_Y, muY)
CHANNELS.CONSTRUCTOR_PATH: obtc02_protocol.yaml point.muY -> gate_obtc02.load() -> SPEC['point']['muY'] -> protocol_obtc02.spec_for() {k: PT[k] for k in (...,'muY')} -> lawspec_v2.spec_with() -> type('SpecVariant',(kinetics.Spec,),d) -> World.sp.muY -> engine_obtc.WorldOBTC._decay_core
CHANNELS.RESOURCE_OR_CAPACITY_DEPENDENCE: none. It reads no resource, no capacity, no position, no age and no lineage label.
CHANNELS.EVENT_ORDER: 6th of 7, AFTER _react: newborns are exposed to decay in their birth step
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: PARTIAL, same reason as kY: removing a Y removes a source cell.
CHANNELS.INDEPENDENTLY_CONTROLLABLE: yes with respect to kY; NO with respect to itself — it sets the founder clock and the newborn clock with one number (see the timescale-collapse finding)

CHANNELS.NAME: p_hop_Y (minority transport)
CHANNELS.MANIFEST_FIELD: NONE. There is no p_hop_Y key in obtc02_protocol.yaml.
CHANNELS.DEFAULT_VALUE: protocol_obtc02.spec_for: 0.0 under the declared immobilisation intervention, otherwise PT['p_hop'] = 0.10263340389897246
CHANNELS.ADMISSIBLE_RANGE: [0, 1] at the engine level; {0, p_hop_X} at the protocol level
CHANNELS.CONSTRUCTOR_PATH: obtc02_protocol.yaml point.p_hop -> spec_for -> d['p_hop_Y'] = 0.0 if immobile_organiser else PT['p_hop'] -> Spec.p_hop_Y -> _diffuse('Y', sp.p_hop_Y)
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: _diffuse('Y', p_hop_Y): four sequential passes in the frozen order ((1,0),(-1,0),(1,1),(-1,1)), each Binomial(n, p_hop/4), accepting min(movers, dest_free) per cell
CHANNELS.STATE_DELTA: n['Y'] redistributed; the COUNT is conserved
CHANNELS.RESOURCE_OR_CAPACITY_DEPENDENCE: acceptance is capped by dest_free at the destination
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_NONZERO_WITHOUT_CODE_CHANGE: at the engine level yes; through the qualified protocol only 0 or p_hop_X
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: NO. It is aliased to p_hop_X in spec_for, and even at the engine level it shifts the shared random stream, so the X draws of the same step move with it.
CHANNELS.MUTATION_ORACLE_RESULT: PASS as a transport channel (hazard 0 -> 0.25, count conserved, configuration set changes, reversal bit-exact)

CHANNELS.NAME: organiser_off_at (declared intervention)
CHANNELS.MANIFEST_FIELD: window.SOURCE_OFF_AT, used only in condition R
CHANNELS.DEFAULT_VALUE: None outside condition R; 4000 in condition R
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: after _one_step: n['Y'] -= y ; n['WY'] += y, all Y at once
CHANNELS.STATE_DELTA: the whole Y field is moved to WY, once
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: NO — it is designed to abolish the source
CHANNELS.INDEPENDENTLY_CONTROLLABLE: it is a one-shot removal, not a rate; it cannot define a timescale
CHANNELS.MUTATION_ORACLE_RESULT: not run: it is a declared intervention already exercised by condition R, and it is not a persistence control

CHANNELS.NAME: S0 and phi (substrate set-point and exchange rate for SY)
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: _exchange: for s in ('SX','SY'): offers[s] = Binomial(max(S0 - n[s], 0), phi)
CHANNELS.STATE_DELTA: SY inserted and an equal number of units removed from {SX,SY,WX,WY}
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: NO. The loop 'for s in ("SX","SY")' applies the SAME S0 and the SAME phi to both substrates. The Y substrate supply cannot be moved without moving the X substrate supply identically.
CHANNELS.MUTATION_ORACLE_RESULT: not applicable as a Y-specific control: it is provably shared

CHANNELS.NAME: omega (waste outflow)
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: read ONLY in kinetics.World._feed_and_outflow and in the v1 branch of WorldV2._feed_and_outflow, both of which are bypassed under LAWSPEC_V2_EXCHANGE
CHANNELS.CAN_BE_VARIED_WITHOUT_CHANGING_X_BASELIN: trivially yes: it changes nothing at all
CHANNELS.MUTATION_ORACLE_RESULT: PROVED INERT: omega 0.0 vs 0.9 gives an identical final state hash and an identical captured hazard sequence

CHANNELS.NAME: a Y-specific precursor pool, or a Y removal that reads age, position or contact
CHANNELS.SCHEDULER_EVENT: _decay_core draws Binomial(n['Y'], muY) over the whole Y field. It reads no age, no position, no contact and no lineage label. Y is absent from EXCHANGEABLE_DEFAULT and from EXCHANGEABLE_WITH_BODY, so the chemostat cannot remove it either.
CHANNELS.MUTATION_ORACLE_RESULT: n/a — there is nothing to perturb

K_Y_PATH: ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTOR_TO_SCHEDULER (rate zero at the qualified point) = DORMANT_BUT_REACHABLE_CHANNEL
MU_Y_PATH: ACTIVE_CONSTRUCTOR_TO_SCHEDULER (rate zero at the qualified point) = DORMANT_BUT_REACHABLE_CHANNEL
